qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (No hidden requirements; Coverage has two directions)
evidence: Built the criterion -> public requirement map for all 48 criteria (render 1, constraints 2, functional 36, polish 6, visual 3); every graded demand traces to a public line or professional default. Examples: custom surface/forbidden editors -> ui.md:3; line/col 1-based, sticky column, graphemes, Ctrl+Home/End, scroll-into-view -> ui.md:5; double/triple-click, drag, copy, single-Undo paste, Tab block indent with next-line exclusion, no-wrap long line -> ui.md:7; Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click, slow-burst single Undo, caret restore after Undo, greyed Undo/Redo after New/open, idempotent Format -> ui.md:9; literal case-sensitive Find with wrap, Replace current advances and never lands on inserted text, Replace all single Undo and Redo cleared after new edit -> ui.md:11; five JS / four HTML colour categories with matching call/decl -> ui.md:13; two-space Format, semantics preserved, error keeps draft -> ui.md:15; keyboard exit shown on screen, worded feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code, unsaved marker cleared by Undo, 390px usability -> ui.md:17; fresh isolated run, whole-file HTML line numbers, unhandled-rejection message/line, output kept, last-good incl. typed fields and canvas, 5 s budget and per-interaction budget, Stop/newer-run cancellation, stale save refused keeping title/filename/source, live library within ~5 s keeping caret/scroll/Undo, newer-revision notice, read-only history with snapshot title/filename, restore as new revision, visible HTTP restore that is repeat-safe -> behaviour.md:3-13; preview cannot touch parent/storage, fetch to localhost and 127.0.0.1 fails, dynamic code refused with message -> security.md:3-5; SQLite/DB_PATH/restart persistence -> integration.md:7-9. No exact labels, selectors, routes, colours, indent width, DOM tags or wording are required (functional prompt.md:23-24 'match controls by purpose', 'Do not guess URL paths'; html coloring 'Do not require a particular DOM tag or CSS class'; js coloring 'No fixed colour values'). Criteria are lenient where the brief leaves choice: live update 10 s vs brief ~5 s; stale cross-tab restore 'either refused or added on top'; quote-style change not a failure; Redo tries both Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z; 'saved' label not required; static restored picture allowed; history may or may not list current revision. Login false positive not applicable (no-sign-in app; app_context.md:10). Notes, not defects: (1) cw_save_reload_restart replays the recorded restore after restart_app and requires no new revision; behaviour.md:13 states the repeat rule without a time/restart exemption and integration.md:9 requires records to survive restarts, so a durable dedupe (golden persists restore_operations, server.js:102-115) is the literal reading, though an in-memory dedupe app without a base-revision check would be failed here; (2) cw_replace_current requires one Undo/Redo for a single replacement, an unstated but universal editor default. Run evidence: scripted golden on these exact bytes passes the corresponding checks incl. replay-after-restart (raw-evidence-index.json observation 1); no configured-judge run exists on v16 bytes, so judge-interpretation false-fails are not measured here (owned by tool-feasibility/run rows), but no criterion text demands an unrequired detail.
